outcome: Frequency and severity of feeding hypoxemia
cohort: 521 healthy infants weighing at least 2000 g and born at a gestational age of at least 36 weeks.
finding: Neonatal respiratory inhibition (NRI) was observed in 51.4% of healthy infants, and while most cases resolved by discharge, feeding hypoxemia persisted in a significant proportion, with breastfeeding showing a potential protective effect.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of NRI.
